This '''B2-HA super battle droid''' was part of [[Nashtah Team]] under the command of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] during [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane's]] [[Battle of Devaron/Legends|attack]] on the [[Temple of Eedit/Legends|Temple of Eedit]] on [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]]. It was unable to differentiate between Sing and [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], which led to one of its B1 colleagues calling him a "glitch-head."
